summary: Wasco County peak with a USFS lookout tower, listed as built in the 1930s and now gone; no source describes the summit today.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Former Fire Lookout Sites register, firelookout.com and the firelookout.org list; no source describes remains on the site

events.note: Registered with the Former Fire Lookout Sites register on August 16, 2010

evidence.supports: Tower built by the USFS in the 1930s; now gone
evidence.quote: This tower was built by the USFS in the 1930s and is now gone.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: no construction year, staffing, fire or removal history found in four pages, and two web searches returned nothing usable. Location conflict: firelookout.com says about 27 miles southeast of Mount Hood in Mount Hood NF; the Rex's page gives Warm Springs Indian Agency, 6S-11E-12. The register and firelookout.com agree on elevation (3,725 ft). The brief's access 'unknown' is left unfilled because no source states access. Peakvisor lists 1,138 m, not used.
